plateaued.instructions: Has the win rate plateaued: no meaningful improvement across the recent training chunks, without having reached the phase target?

rally_farming.instructions: Is the agent rally-farming: a high hit rate and long rallies but a low win rate, exploiting the hit reward instead of trying to score?

value_diverging.instructions: Is the value function diverging or the policy destabilizing: value loss or KL growing persistently across recent updates?

entropy_collapsed.instructions: Has policy entropy collapsed too early, leaving too little exploration for the agent to discover scoring strategies?

reward_knob.instructions: Which reward shaping parameter most needs adjustment to improve the win rate in this phase?

criteria.hit_reward: Reward paid once per successful paddle hit; bootstraps motor skills but can teach rally-farming
criteria.tracking_reward: Small per-step reward for aligning the paddle with an approaching ball
criteria.pressure_scale: Reward per return proportional to how far the opponent is from the predicted ball arrival
criteria.step_penalty: Per-step penalty encouraging shorter rallies and faster games
criteria.none: Reward shaping is fine; do not change it

reward_adjustment.instructions: How should the chosen reward parameter be adjusted? Prefer small changes unless the metric evidence is severe.

hp_knob.instructions: Which PPO hyperparameter most needs adjustment given the training metrics (losses, entropy, KL, win rate trend)?

criteria.learning_rate: PPO learning rate; lower when forgetting or instability appears, higher when learning stalls
criteria.ent_coef: Entropy coefficient; higher encourages exploration, lower sharpens the policy
criteria.n_steps: Rollout length per environment before each PPO update
criteria.clip_range: PPO clipping range; lower makes updates more conservative
criteria.none: Hyperparameters are fine; do not change them

hp_adjustment.instructions: How should the chosen hyperparameter be adjusted? Prefer small changes unless the metric evidence is severe.

obs_feature.instructions: Would adding one of these observation features help the agent learn faster in this phase? Enabling a feature restarts training from a fresh model, so only choose one if the current observation is clearly missing information the agent needs.

criteria.paddle_velocity: Player paddle y-velocity; gives the policy its own movement intent
criteria.intercept_y: Predicted ball y at the player paddle plane with wall bounces; a head start on positioning
criteria.relative_offset: Signed vertical distance between paddle and ball; direct tracking error
criteria.none: The current observation vector is sufficient

phase_health.instructions: Rate the overall health of training in phase 5: is it failing, struggling, progressing, or on track?
